dedupe_keys.name: global daily simplified wet bulb globe temperature 1940 2022

description: The WBGT climate-network team releases a global daily maximum simplified wet-bulb globe temperature product from 1940 to 2022. The own Figshare record links CC BY 4.0 and lists separate data, network-metric, climate-network and program archives. The article reports a two-degree grid and NetCDF temperature-stress variables; network objects are serialized in Python pickle format. The gridded series can support heat-exposure or health-service stress scenarios, while network outputs describe spatial association. A caveat is that simplified WBGT is calculated from reanalysis, not measured with a full outdoor globe thermometer, and two-degree cells obscure urban heat islands. Pickle files should only be opened in a trusted execution setting. I read the own Figshare file manifest and article Data Records without downloading archives, executing scripts or checking local exposure accuracy. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
